sections.advice: This Geysir area → Gullfoss stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Gullfoss → Laugarvatn food is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

scenicChapters.title: Segment Masho - Piticocha → Segment Casila Alto - Chillaco
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 76 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-segment-san-juan-de-tantaranche-h.story: From Sangallaya it runs 296 km to Sangallaya; allow about 5 h 06 of riding. It goes by way of Segment Masho - Piticocha, Segment Casila Alto - Chillaco, Segment Sisicaya - Santa Rosa de Chontay and Segment Molle - Huarangal. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
